scope: Pure in-memory validation of an already acquired command dictionary. No producer changes, acquisition, source-method authority, workflow, native operation or full run/physical acceptance.

api.ordinary_path: Requires rc0, no supervision failure, unchanged resource bounds, no cleanup signals/live members, memory_read_error None and memory_terminal_resolution None. A retained last sample is checked against original limits.
api.ordinary_deadline_limit: Total elapsed includes cleanup and is not a separate pre-cleanup deadline timestamp. Ordinary path returns pre_cleanup_command_deadline_proved=False; it does not infer that fact.
api.declared_timeout: Raw supervised .command.json has no requested_timeout_seconds. If present (controller-enriched record), exact int equality to seconds is required. requested_timeout_recorded/requested_timeout_bound report whether the field exists. Caller must require its normal declared timeout/argv gate.
api.resolved_path: Requires the exact typed ExhaustedMissingRSS error and retained original CounterError, terminal_complete before cleanup, no fake fresh RSS or PF_EXITING acceptance, three ordered MissingRSS histories, observed resource-bound replay, and final complete identity scans within the original 100ms snapshot budget.
api.error_preservation: Original record and all diagnostic/error/history fields remain untouched; returned retained_memory_read_error repeats the original error.
api.external_authentication: source_authenticated, event_authenticated and stream_bytes_authenticated always False. These describe caller responsibilities rather than asserting absent authentication.

semantic_source_map.checks: Exactly attempts1/2/3 with retry_missing_live_counter; all enumerated identities held stable across attempts; observations equal the exact enumeration prefix ending in one missing-live counter. No enumeration disappearances.

Expected/before/after pid+pgrp+starttime identity, live/nonrunning dispositions and missing-file/hashed-status shape are replayed. Missing counters cannot carry RSS. Valid preceding measured RSS is summed solely as a lower bound.
All observed available-memory and partial measured-RSS limits, exact observed_resource_bounds, original error, pre-cleanup flags, parent rc0 and finite original snapshot timestamps/budget.

Every poll retained. Earlier incomplete censuses may contain anchored known live children, with exact live-list replay and known-identity coverage. Final two scans must be complete, with no live/unknown/reused/unanchored identities.

Checked time.monotonic decision, finite same-clock values, exact arithmetic, correct1200/14400 limit and strict observation<deadline. Equal/late/unavailable decisions refuse. Command total elapsed must cover the decision; cleanup duration is not used as a replacement deadline.
rc0, no supervision_failure, unchanged resource constants, no cleanup signals/live members; nonrunning residuals remain visible.

explicit_conservative_restrictions: Unknown identity evidence in any recorded terminal census is rejected, even if a later census is clean. Known live intermediate children are allowed.
A known PID reported gone cannot reappear in a later recorded terminal scan; ambiguous disappearance/reappearance stays rejected.

Status/disappearance error records must identify FileNotFoundError or ProcessLookupError with actual OS errno2/3. Permission/malformed/system-counter errors cannot become MissingRSS terminal resolution.
facts_not_reconstructed_from_missing_byt: The histories contain no per-attempt timestamps. Exactly two20ms sleeps are guaranteed by caller-authenticated producer code and hosted producer controls, not inferred from invented history timestamps.
A status_sha256 shape is checked, but original raw proc status bytes are not available to this helper.
Full /proc enumeration and event/command equality require authenticated producer code and actual caller evidence; enumerated_count alone does not independently authenticate the operating system.
No native prefix success is inferred. Run40878295979/sourcea32414f was running at assignment; failed40863684870 is not a qualified prefix.

actual_producer_cases: parent finished while known child exits during remaining original window
authored_controls.known_child_fixture: Calls unchanged synthetic_case and actual returned module.supervised/snapshot/resolve_terminal. Only its existing fake Process is wrapped to expose its fake clock, and its fault selector models an anchored child alive at90ms then gone at95ms. No production function is replaced.
authored_controls.temporary_directory_retention: Wraps only the existing fixture's TemporaryDirectory lifetime; reads actual command.json/events.jsonl before owned synthetic directories are cleaned. Actual command and event diagnostic equality is checked in the hosted test.
regressions: Actual frozen old body: third MissingRSS observation triggers SIGTERM; final rc0 still has memory_sample_unavailable and is rejected.
Authenticated actual pre-amendment body: command finishes after1200 seconds with no strict command_budget_decision; rejected despite its original success return.

caller_integration_required: Root must pin the new helper/checker/review and unchanged producer dependencies in its exact-source method and qualify the authored checker on GitHub.
Caller must authenticate source/method, raw command record, corresponding event/stream bytes and archive/projection joins. This helper cannot provide those facts.
Prefix and route consumers retain exact argv/label/requested_timeout_seconds and original phase ordering, engine/input identities and numerical/geometry/audit gates.
Use1200 for original preparation/audit commands and14400 for the single routing attempt. Do not clear memory_read_error to satisfy historical consumers.
Actual prefix receipt/frozen inventory/source pins must come from successful new terminal evidence before tail authorization; failed historical prefix remains failed.
